Multiple witnesses on the flight stated that the man was extremely belligerent towards her, to the point where he took off his watch and threw it at her. When officers questioned the man, he stated that he had to much to drink and couldn't remember what had happened. When officers had questioned the woman, she said nothing sever had happened and was trying to protect the man, instead of stating what had happened.
